description: European public-procurement contract awards won by a company from Latvia (LV), Norway (NO), Belgium (BE), Denmark (DK), Finland (FI), Sweden (SE), Czechia (CZ), Slovakia (SK), Estonia (EE) or Lithuania (LT), from TED (Tenders Electronic Daily, EU Publications Office): award notices matched by the NATIONAL identifier in every form it takes on TED (`variantes_identifiant`): buyer, country, subject, notice-level amount, CPV codes, official TED link, co-winners proven legal persons (other names and IDs counted by reason, never named). Depending on the country, 40 to 94% of award notices carry a readable winner identifier (measured 2026-09-17): `nombre_avis: 0` is a NON-conclusive absence. Czechia, Denmark, Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia, Norway, Sweden and Slovakia: legal persons only; returns 404, not billed: in Czechia, a sole trader's or other natural person's IČO (the majority of Czech identifiers) or a form not recognised as a legal person; in Denmark, a sole proprietorship (ENK), a personally owned small business (PMV), an estate (DØD) or an undecided CVR form; in Estonia, a sole proprietorship (FIE) or a form not recognised as a legal person; in Lithuania, an individual enterprise (individuali įmonė, IĮ), its branch (individualios įmonės filialas) or representative office (individualios įmonės atstovybė), or an undecided form; in Latvia, an individual merchant (IK), an individual (IND), family (GIM), farm (ZEM) or fishery (ZVJ) enterprise, or an unrecognised legal form; in Norway, a sole proprietorship (ENK), a registered individual (PERS, TVAM), an estate (KBO, BO), a foreign branch or entity (NUF, UTLA) whose name does not end with a written legal-person form valid in its home country (followed at most by branch words), or recorded there as a sole proprietorship, or a form not recognised as a legal person; in Sweden, a sole proprietorship (enskild näringsverksamhet) or an undecided form; in Slovakia, an entity of the trade register, a sole trader of the commercial register or a form not recognised as a legal person. So does a Belgian entity without legal form or of a form off the whitelist, or a Finnish form off the YRMU codebook. France has get_french_company_eu_procurement, the UK get_uk_company_public_procurement. Live TED query, cached 24 h. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.
